subject: Long wait time when using large list for UI dropdown menu

messages.author: 59da00f7146cd649
messages.subject: Long wait time when using large list for UI dropdown menu
parts:
Hi,

I have been working on a Shiny app that has multiple UI tabs, each with several dropdown menu. The selectionInput used for each dropdown menu is about ~20000 options. Furthermore, my current code setup will go through all UI tabs (i.e. all dropdown menu I used in my app) when I start it. And it seems to be causing long wait-time (~45 seconds) when deployed on a server, as when I shortened the options to ~5 for testing, the app starts running immediately when I open it. 

My questions are
     (1) Is there any way to decrease the wait time if I were to keep the current options for my dropdown menu? 
     (2) Is there any good way to setup the app such that it only 'source' a UI tab when the user first click it rather than going through all UI tabs when I initiate the app?

Thanks!
